messages:
jess_k: Hey team — I tried to apply the promo code I got in the onboarding email (WELCOME50) and the UI returns 'Promo code rejected: invalid or expired'. Can someone check? I'm mid-integration and need the trial credits.

sam_support: Hey @jess_k — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact code and the email/account id you used? Screenshot would help too.

jess_k: Code is WELCOME50, account email jess.k@example.com. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/screenshots/err-1728245123.png The message is a yellow banner: "Promo code rejected: invalid or expired".

sam_support: Thanks. I created a quick ticket: ticket-bot created INC-2024-987 in support queue. Adding @maria_billing to confirm whether the promo was revoked/expired. :white_check_mark:

maria_billing: Looking now. Searching the partner promo table — WELCOME50 was a campaign code issued for Jan 2024 with expiry 2024-03-31, so it shows as expired in the promo engine.

jess_k: Huh — but the email said "valid for 6 months" and we signed up in Feb. Is there any chance it was set incorrectly? :confused:

sam_support: Could be a config error. Two options: 1) we can grant manual credits to your account now so you can continue integration, or 2) we can extend the promo's expiry if it was a bug. Which do you prefer?

jess_k: Manual credits would be fastest. Need roughly $50 to run load tests.

maria_billing: I can do a manual grant. Please confirm account id (internal) so I apply to the right org. Also note: I will add a note on the promo lifecycle so the campaigns team can audit the mismatch.

sam_support: @jess_k what's your account id? You can get it from Console > Settings, or I can look up from the email.

jess_k: Account id is acct_01G6Z9Y5KLMN.

maria_billing: Confirmed. Applying a $50 trial credit to acct_01G6Z9Y5KLMN now.

maria_billing: Done. I added a memo: "Manual grant for expired promo WELCOME50 — user reported email claimed 6 months validity." Internal ref INC-2024-987.

sam_support: I see the credit on the admin ledger. Can you refresh your Console billing page @jess_k and confirm balance?

jess_k: Refreshing... I can see a $50 promotional credit under Billing -> Credits. It also shows expires 2024-09-01. Thank you!! :tada:

maria_billing: Great. I'll keep INC-2024-987 open and loop in campaigns to check why the original promo expiry is mismatched. Next steps for us: 1) investigate email template & campaign expiry; 2) consider retroactive extension for impacted users if required.

sam_support: Marking thread as resolved after you confirm integration is unblocked. Anything else we can do right now?

jess_k: All good for now. Please keep me posted on the campaigns fix. Really appreciate the quick help.

sam_support: Will do. Closing this thread but will update INC-2024-987 when campaigns responds. :thumbsup:
